name: sgs/choice-flow-result
title: SGS Choice Flow — Result
description: The recommendation terminal for a Choice Flow — shows a heading and result text, optionally matched against a weighted tag set (Spec 43 FR-43-3/FR-43-12).

heading.label: Result heading
heading._note: Renders as <h3 class="sgs-choice-flow-result__heading">, a RichText-bound plain string attribute (no source:html — this is a dynamic, render.php-only block with no save.js, so nothing ever parses the attribute back out of saved markup). clusters: [] is a genuine gap — no per-instance colour/typography attribute exists on this block this phase; styled by shared framework CSS only.

body.label: Result body
body._note: Renders as <div class="sgs-choice-flow-result__body">, a RichText-bound plain string attribute allowing basic inline formatting (no source:html — same reason as heading). clusters: [] is a genuine gap — same as heading.

action.description: FR-43-20 (v1.4.0): 'recommend' (default) is this block's original plain result screen. 'add-to-bag' shows a summary of the chosen priced add-ons and an Add to bag button that POSTs the page's product/variation (or the flow's own `flowProductId`) plus every priced answer on the path taken to /sgs/v1/cart/add-item — the same secure proxy sgs/buybox already uses. 'email' (FR-43-4) shows an email-capture form that POSTs to /sgs/v1/choice-flow/submit — the path's answers plus the address, stored as a form submission and forwarded to N8N, no wp_mail().

rateLimit.description: FR-43-4: maximum email submissions accepted per IP address, per hour, for this result step. Read server-side only — never trusted from the request.

successMessage.default: Thanks — we'll be in touch shortly.

showAddToBasket.description: D3 (Bean's 2026-09-26 review): shows an 'Add to basket' button in the flow's footer while this add-to-bag terminal is the current step. Switching both this and showBuyNow off leaves the footer with no primary action on this step.

buttonShowsTotal.description: FR-43-24: the flow's running total follows the purchase button's label, e.g. 'Add to bag  £418.00'.

showBuyNow.description: D3: shows a 'Buy now' button in the flow's footer — the same add-to-cart request as Add to basket, then straight to checkout.

attributes.heading: Your recommended treatment
attributes.body: Based on your answers, we think this is the best fit for you.
